values.review_scope: Review the WP-18B real-provider harness, validator, matrix, redacted traces, negative artifacts, and exact proof paths for identical scenario/ACIP semantics, no substitution, credential safety, provider-loss isolation, and scope discipline.
review_prompts: Do two real providers, rather than fixtures or cached output, complete the same scenario?
Are identity, authority, ordering, ACIP operations, and result semantics provider-neutral?
Do provider loss and substitution attempts fail visibly without collapsing Runtime?
Are all traces useful but credential-free and appropriately redacted?
